description: Everything FlyTrap recorded for one bug: the test scenario and failed step, screenshots and UI XML (signed URLs, valid for a short time), the logcat error window, failed network calls, performance peaks and a ready-to-use ai_prompt. Cite run.crawl_run_id and the screenshot path when you explain the bug. Requires FLYTRAP_API_KEY.
name: get_bug_evidence
title: Get bug evidence
